text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text: "Dear Teacher,"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"I'm writing you a letter again after so long.
Since it's international mail,
it will probably take a little while to arrive."
choice_data_list: So, about what time we're supposed to arrive at the venue tomorrow—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
We already talked about that at noon.
Double-checking pointlessly isn't like you.
……You chickening out?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Hah.
Hey, let's step outside for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text: "『I believe you, my revered teacher, will be reading this letter after the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe is over... after I have finished running.』"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"I have no intention of holding a grudge over
you not coming to watch me.
Nor do I really plan on sharing life updates."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text: "There is simply one more thing I wish to wager."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Brrr…… Nights really get chilly, huh.
Autumn's definitely already here……
choice_data_list: Don't let yourself get cold, you hear?
Make sure you don't get chilled, okay?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah. ...Ooh, the stars are quite pretty tonight.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text: "Sensei. I won, didn't I?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Doesn't it sound like a foolish thing to say?
Yet, writing just this single line
took surprisingly much longer than expected."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"‘Even though I was just talking big like usual,
the reason my hands were trembling a little...
might be because this is my final move.’"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Some said
they would bet their own experience on me."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Another person said
they would bet their life on me."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Another told me...
that they would follow me to the depths of hell.
That they would stake their entire life on me."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"To pour so much into taking on this challenge.
If so, I wanted to wager my everything as well.
After rushing, getting confused, and losing my way, what remained was—"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"One last thing. A tiny prayer.
With this, I go all-in."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"There is no retreat, nor are there any excuses left.
I pray that my victory will make your heart beat just a little faster."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Sincerely yours,
Nakayama Festa"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Let's go show 'em what we've got tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And so, the night at Longchamp deepens.
